Flying Discs Show Sign
Of Guidance, Jung Says
ALAMOGORDO, N. Mex., July 29 (AP)—Dr. Carl Jung, Swiss psychologist, says in a report that Unidentified Flying Objects are real and “show signs of intelligent guidance by quasi-human pilots.”
Dr. Jung, who started his research on UFO’s in 1944, released his report through the UFO filter Center of the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization here. It was released by L. J. Lorenzen of Holoman Air Force Base.
